Run a specialized slide computation on a single epi_df epikey, with temporary completion

Source: R/epi_slide_opt_edf.R
epi_slide_opt_edf_one_epikey.Rd

Run a specialized slide computation on a single epi_df epikey, with temporary completion

Usage

epi_slide_opt_edf_one_epikey(
  inp_tbl,
  in_colnames,
  f_dots_baked,
  f_from_package,
  before_n_steps,
  after_n_steps,
  unit_step,
  time_type,
  out_colnames,
  out_filter_time_range,
  out_filter_time_set,
  inf_slide_time_min
)

Arguments

inp_tbl

tibble; should have a time_value column and columns named in in_colnames; should not contain any columns named in out_colnames

in_colnames

chr; names of columns to which to apply f_dots_baked

f_dots_baked

supported sliding function from {data.table} or {slider}, potentially with some arguments baked in with purrr::partial

f_from_package

string; name of package from which f_dots_baked (pre-partial) originates

before_n_steps

integerish >=0 or Inf; number of time steps before each ref_time_value to include in the sliding window computation; Inf to include all times beginning with the min time_value

after_n_steps

integerish >=0; number of time steps after each ref_time_value to include in the sliding window computation

time_type

as in new_epi_archive

out_colnames

chr, same length as in_colnames; column names to use for results

out_filter_time_range, out_filter_time_set

time_value filter; time_values in the output should match the result of applying this filter to inp_tbl$time_value. Exactly one of the two must be provided (non-NULL) and the other must be NULL. out_filter_time_range, if provided, should be a length-2 vector/list containing the minimum and maximum time_value to allow in the output. out_filter_time_set, if provided, should be a vector of time_values to intersect with the input time_values.

inf_slide_time_min

NULL or a single time_value; when before_n_steps is Inf, the time at which the "sliding" (actually, running) windows start. NULL will use each epikey's min time_value rather than the overall; pass the minimum time_value across all epikeys to treat times before this epikey's first time_value as (NA-padded) gaps, matching epi_slide.

Value

tibble; like inp_tbl with addition of out_colnames holding the slide computation results, with times filtered down as specified. If there is nothing to slide over (0 rows output), the out_colnames columns will be omitted; when combining with other epikeys' results, e.g., via dplyr::bind_rows, they will be filled in with the appropriate types.

Examples


library(dplyr)
tbl <- tibble(
  time_value = c(11:12, 15:18) + 0,
  value = c(c(1, 2), c(4, 8, 16, 32))
)

tbl %>%
  epiprocess:::epi_slide_opt_edf_one_epikey(
    "value",
    data.table::frollmean, "data.table",
    1L, 0L, 1L, "integer",
    "slide_value",
    c(11L, 16L), NULL,
    NULL
  )
#> # A tibble: 4 × 3
#>   time_value value slide_value
#>        <int> <dbl>       <dbl>
#> 1         11     1        NA  
#> 2         12     2         1.5
#> 3         15     4        NA  
#> 4         16     8         6  

tbl %>%
  epiprocess:::epi_slide_opt_edf_one_epikey(
    "value",
    data.table::frollmean, "data.table",
    0L, 1L, 1L, "integer",
    "slide_value",
    NULL, c(11, 15, 16, 17, 18),
    NULL
  )
#> # A tibble: 5 × 3
#>   time_value value slide_value
#>        <dbl> <dbl>       <dbl>
#> 1         11     1         1.5
#> 2         15     4         6  
#> 3         16     8        12  
#> 4         17    16        24  
#> 5         18    32        NA  

tbl %>%
  epiprocess:::epi_slide_opt_edf_one_epikey(
    "value",
    data.table::frollmean, "data.table",
    Inf, 0L, 1L, "integer",
    "slide_value",
    NULL, c(12, 17),
    NULL
  )
#> # A tibble: 2 × 3
#>   time_value value slide_value
#>        <dbl> <dbl>       <dbl>
#> 1         12     2         1.5
#> 2         17    16        NA
